# Gallop

> Gallop is an AI-native modernization platform that reads an enterprise's entire codebase, maps every business capability it holds, and rebuilds it on modern, agent-ready foundations — with zero business logic lost.

Gallop pairs AI agents with a human-in-the-loop verification process (the Reliability Mesh) to migrate legacy systems — COBOL, .NET, Java, PL/SQL, and more — onto modern cloud and language stacks. It deploys inside the customer's own environment (SaaS, private cloud, on-prem, or fully air-gapped) and is held to SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001.

## Product

- [Methodology](https://www.gallopintelligence.ai/d-methodology.html): The Gallop Way — six principles for AI-accelerated software transformation.
- [Request a demo](https://www.gallopintelligence.ai/d-contact.html): See Gallop discover, plan, and modernize a real capability live, on your own architecture.

## Case studies

- [How a Fortune-Scale Global Retailer Understood a 7M+ Line ERP System in 3 Weeks](https://www.gallopintelligence.ai/d-blog-retailer-discover.html): Gallop Discover mapped a 20-year-old, 7M+ line merchandising system and delivered a priced target architecture in 3 weeks, against a prior $1M, 9-month static assessment.
- [How a Fortune Scale Global Retailer Achieved a 20x Effort Reduction in ERP Modernization](https://www.gallopintelligence.ai/d-blog-retailer-dms.html): A 15-year-old distributor management system was rebuilt in one quarter, migrating 700+ distributor organizations with zero downtime.
- [How a Banking Analytics Firm Modernized Its Investment Platform in 16 Weeks](https://www.gallopintelligence.ai/d-blog-banking-analytics.html): A legacy VB.NET investment analytics application was rebuilt on a modern cloud architecture, owned end to end by the client's own team.
- [How a Global Home Appliances Leader Rebuilt a Mission-Critical Field App in 4 Weeks](https://www.gallopintelligence.ai/d-blog-the-story.html): An Android field app used by 10,000+ engineers was rebuilt in Flutter, cutting the codebase by 65%.
- [All case studies](https://www.gallopintelligence.ai/d-blog.html)
